name: St. Lawrence County, NY
findings: St. Lawrence County has 344 nonprofit organizations. 173 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 150 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Lawrence County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 17 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do health care organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 16 would.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in St. Lawrence County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
